dialogs.about: 손녀와 내일 소풍 이야기를 하며 날씨를 걱정해요

lines.en: Grandma, are we going to the park tomorrow?
Yes, we will go, unless it rains.
lines.ko: 네, 비가 오지 않으면 갈 거예요.

lines.en: What will we do if it rains?
Then we will bake cookies instead.
Cookies! Actually, I like that idea better.
Me too. Did you finish your school work?
Yes, finally! I finished it this morning.
lines.ko: 네, 드디어 다 했어요! 오늘 아침에 끝냈어요.

lines.en: Good. Take your umbrella, otherwise you will get wet.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 우산 가져가요. 안 그러면 비 맞아요.

lines.en: Okay. Anyway, can we buy sugar today, please?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 그런데 오늘 설탕 사러 갈까요?

lines.en: Sure. Let's go to the shop now.
Hi! Are you waiting for the bus?
Hi. Yes, I am going to the market.
It is late again. It comes every hour.
lines.ko: 또 늦네요. 한 시간에 한 번 와요.

lines.en: Then should we walk instead?
It is rather far. Besides, my knee hurts.
Anyway, let's wait here. I have an umbrella.
lines.ko: 어쨌든 여기서 기다려요. 저한테 우산이 있어요.

lines.en: Thank you. Did it rain here yesterday?
Yes. I got wet here yesterday.
Oh, finally! Here comes the bus.
Good. I will sit by the window.
